# Capital Stay UAE

> Capital Stay is a DTCM-licensed holiday home operator in Dubai. We rent luxury, fully serviced short-term apartments and villas to guests, and manage holiday homes end to end for property owners (licensing, listing, pricing, guest care, cleaning and maintenance).

## Key facts
- Business: luxury short-term rentals (holiday homes) and holiday home management
- Licence: holiday home operator licensed by Dubai's Department of Tourism and Commerce Marketing (DTCM)
- Coverage: Dubai (Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, Palm Jumeirah, JVC, JLT, Al Barsha, Al Furjan and more), plus Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah and Umm Al Quwain
- Listed on: Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia and our direct booking site
- Guest services: airport transfers, daily maid service, luxury car rental, private chef, yacht charters
- Booking: https://booking.capitalstayuae.com/
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 54 704 7913
- Email: hellodubai@capitalstayuae.com
- Office: Abdullah Kamber Business Center, Deira, Dubai, UAE
